title: stanleya pinnata var. inyoensis
intro: Stanleya pinnata var. inyoensis, commonly known as Inyo blazing star or Inyo desert marigold, is a plant species in the family Plumbaginaceae. This plant is used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Stanleya pinnata var. inyoensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids. Additionally, the plant's bioactive constituents, including inyoin, have been shown to have potential anti-cancer and neuroprotective effects, making it a valuable resource in the field of herbal medicine.
